title: Zesty Sour Vietnamese Shrimp Ca Kho To
description: A traditional Vietnamese dish featuring shrimp and rice paper sheets in a sour and savory broth, made with long fermentation dough for a unique flavor and texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine shrimp, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, ginger, bird eye chili, sea salt, and black pepper, and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Soak the rice paper sheets in warm water for about 30 seconds to soften them.
Remove the shrimp from the marinade and set aside.
In a large pot, combine the long fermentation dough and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the marinated shrimp to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the shrimp are pink and fully cooked.
To assemble the dish, place a softened rice paper sheet on a flat surface and add a few pieces of the cooked shrimp in the center of the sheet.
Fold the bottom half of the sheet up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the sheet to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
